Navi Mumbai bus driver arrested for alleged assault of 3-year-old girl

A 30-year-old school bus driver was arrested in Navi Mumbai's Kamothe area for allegedly sexually assaulting a three-year-old girl inside the bus. The incident reportedly occurred after the girl was the last child to be dropped off. The alleged assault came to light when the child complained of abdominal pain to her grandmother. Police confirmed the sexual assault and arrested the driver, who has been remanded to police custody by a local court. Investigations are ongoing.
